outputs.title:0: 50 years on from Arts Britain Ignores: how much has changed for black and Asian artists?
outputs.excerpt:0: Conference to explore legacy of Naseem Khan’s seminal 1976 report about exclusion of minority ethnic artists It is 50 years since cultural historian Naseem Khan’s challenge to the British arts establishment was first published, and the question of who and what counts as British…
